name: Limonene (d-)
key_uses: Cheap citrus lift; bulk of orange/lemon terpene fraction. IFRA has a Specification (peroxide value/antioxidant), not a fixed Cat 4 % cap.

name: Linalool
key_uses: Ubiquitous fresh-floral lift; core of lavender/bergamot/coriander accords. IFRA Specification on peroxides rather than a fixed Cat 4 % (autoxidation sensitizer).

name: Linalyl acetate
key_uses: Bergamot/lavender heart; classic fougère and cologne accords. Not IFRA-restricted (converts to linalool).

name: Sweet orange oil
key_uses: Sweet fruity-citrus top; cheap volume in colognes and gourmands. Not phototoxic-restricted like bergamot.

name: Grapefruit oil
key_uses: Tart citrus top; boosted with nootkatone/thio-grapefruit specialties. Mildly phototoxic (Specification).

name: Citral
key_uses: Powerful lemon note; used in trace with limonene/geraniol as quencher. IFRA Restriction; Cat 4 ~0.6% (sensitizer).

name: Nerol

name: Geraniol
key_uses: Rose/geranium heart; core rose alcohol. IFRA 51 Restriction ~0.056% Cat 4 (established allergen). Supplier certs may state slightly different %.

name: Citronellol
key_uses: Rose-bud freshness; rose/geranium/muguet accords. IFRA 51 Restriction ~0.076% Cat 4 (allergen).

name: Phenylethyl alcohol
key_uses: Backbone of rose accords; huge dosages tolerated. Fresh watery-rose. Not IFRA-restricted.

name: Geranium oil
key_uses: Natural rose-green heart; fougère and masculine hearts. Restricted indirectly via citronellol/geraniol content.

name: Rose oxide

name: beta-Damascone

name: delta-Damascone

name: beta-Damascenone

name: Ionone (Irone alpha-cis)

name: Hedione (methyl dihydrojasmonate)

name: Benzyl acetate

key_uses: Powdery-honeyed soft floral; mimosa and powdery accords. Restricted via anisaldehyde/allergens — verify.

name: Cyclohexal (Cyclal)
key_uses: Green-muguet-melon aldehyde; green floral and aquatic accords. IFRA Restriction likely — verify.

name: Aldehyde C-6 (Hexanal)
key_uses: Green-grassy fatty aldehyde; green top-notes. Not IFRA-restricted (verify).

name: Aldehyde C-7 (Heptanal)
key_uses: Green-fatty aldehyde; aldehydic accords. Verify IFRA.

name: Phenylacetaldehyde
key_uses: Hyacinth-honey green floral; hyacinth and narcissus accords. IFRA Restriction ~0.015% Cat 4 (allergen; supplier certs vary).

name: Phenylethyl acetate
key_uses: Sweet fruity-rose; rose and honey accords. Not IFRA-restricted.

name: Ethyl linalool
key_uses: Softer, more floral/muguet linalool variant; less citrusy, more stable. Not IFRA-restricted (verify).

name: Tetrahydrolinalool
key_uses: Very stable, base/functional-friendly linalool; clean floral in soap and bleach-stable products. Not IFRA-restricted.

key_uses: Marine-green aldehyde; aquatic and green accords (note: shares CAS/identity with Cyclal/Cyclohexal-type — verify).

name: Dupical
key_uses: Green foliage aldehyde; muguet-green and leafy accords (IFF). Verify IFRA/CAS.

name: Florol
key_uses: Fresh muguet/linden-blossom; modern floral accords (Firmenich). Not IFRA-restricted (verify).

name: para-Cresyl methyl ether
key_uses: Narcissus/animalic phenolic; ylang and white-floral naturalness in trace. Verify IFRA.

name: Nerolidol
key_uses: Soft woody-floral fixative; floral bases and neroli. IFRA Restriction (allergen) — verify Cat 4.

key_uses: Smoky-woody oud/leather substitute; oud and woody accords. Verify IFRA.

name: Tobacco absolute
key_uses: Sweet dried-tobacco; tobacco and amber accords. Verify IFRA.
